title: Gym Exercise Logger
description: A comprehensive fitness tracking platform designed to support gym members and facilities. Track workouts, monitor progress, and achieve goals.

title: ChemRef Hub
description: A comprehensive chemistry database containing chemical formulas, properties, and a suite of mathematical calculators for stoichiometry and reaction analysis.
problem: Students and professionals often struggle to find a centralized, accurate source for chemical data and quick calculation tools.
